mentions.name: RVW
mentions.description: RVW is an adaptation of the standard transformer model capable of online continual learning without catastrophic forgetting. Early experiments are published as a pre-print, and ongoing work scales the approach to more parameters and improves performance, including a Nemotron-flavored variant that showed no forgetting across mixed-domain training, a Llama 3.2-flavored ~2B parameter model in training, and potential future work on Gemma 4.
mentions.problem: Enables online continual learning in transformer models without catastrophic forgetting.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on RVW, my adaptation of the standard transformer model that is capable of online continual learning without catastrophic forgetting.
